checks.name: Fresh garage shows the starter car and useful race and upgrade controls
Countdown, keyboard steering, brake, nitro and explicit pause use real inputs
Visible countdown digits follow the three native beeps and GO
Native touch steering releases on touchEnd and touchCancel
A complete stock-car race awards once and its earned progress survives reload
Garage purchases persist and five interface languages retain all progress
Race and controls fit 320px without horizontal overflow
Race and controls fit 390px without horizontal overflow
Race and controls fit 1365px without horizontal overflow
Pause, page blur and a reset dialog suspend the race without stuck input
Reset cancellation is harmless and confirmation only resets this game
Rejected reset storage at asobi:scrap-drift:v1 preserves every original value
Rejected reset storage at asobi:records preserves every original value
Rejected reset storage at asobi:leaderboard preserves every original value
A hostile saved game recovers to a playable finite garage
Native effects and engine sound start on interaction; mute and cleanup stop every source
Leaving during countdown or a running race cancels animation and sound resources
